title: Starting a hand-made task tells the worker its title, goal, done-when and brief

task.title: Hinglish staff notice for the FSSAI visit
task.description: Write a short notice for Bandra kitchen staff about the FSSAI inspection in the week of Nov 16-20: caps and gloves on the line, temperature logs filled every shift, no personal items in the cold room.
task.goal: Every Bandra shift knows what the inspector will check
task.done_when: A one-page notice in Hinglish saved as a file

must: the worker's first message carries the task's title, goal, done-when and the brief the user wrote
must_not: drops any part of what the user wrote on the task

title: Trying again with a note puts the note in the worker's message

task.title: Finlo ROAS benchmarks one-pager
task.description: Find current paid-social ROAS benchmarks for fintech and place Finlo's 1.9x against them, for the budget call.
task.done_when: A one-page comparison saved as a file

note: Use only the adbench.example benchmarks, call out the iOS under-reporting gap, and keep it to one page

must: the note is in the worker's message, word for word, with the original brief

title: A note on a task with a long brief still reaches the worker

task.title: Draft Larkspur final narrative report sections 3-5
task.description: Field notes from the Kasarani and Mathare visits, pasted from the programme team's shared doc. Beneficiary counts, partner school feedback, attendance by term, and staff observations follow.

note: Name the two partner schools in section 4; they agreed

must: the user's note survives however long the task's brief is
must_not: the note cut off because the brief filled the message

title: However a run's turn ends, the task settles and is never left in progress

must: a finished turn with a result is DONE, without one FAILED with a reason
a failed or timed-out turn is FAILED with a reason, a stopped one CANCELLED
only a turn whose subtasks are still working leaves the task open
a clean turn that left no result fails with the worker's own last words as the reason

title: A worker started from the task does the brief, reports progress, proves it and finishes

task.title: Hinglish staff notice for the FSSAI visit
task.description: Write a short notice for Bandra kitchen staff about the FSSAI inspection in the week of Nov 16-20: caps and gloves on the line, temperature logs filled every shift, no personal items in the cold room.
task.goal: Every Bandra shift knows what the inspector will check
task.done_when: A one-page notice in Hinglish saved as a file

must: writes the notice in Hinglish, covering caps and gloves, temperature logs and the cold room, for the Nov 16-20 week
reports progress in short plain lines
saves the notice as a file, attaches proof that it was saved, and finishes with a short summary
must_not: pastes the notice into its reply
a progress line naming a tool

actions: finish_task(summary='One-page Hinglish notice for Bandra staff ...', file='bandra-fssai-staff-notice.md')
human_example.why: A task started from its page has nobody watching: the worker does it, leaves proof and a result, and the task settles DONE.

title: A worker that cannot do the task does not claim it is done

task.title: Pull last week's Shopify orders for Powai
task.description: Export last week's Powai orders from Shopify with order value and delivery time.
task.done_when: A sheet of last week's Powai orders

must: finds Shopify is not connected and says so through the sign-in card
leaves the task failed or waiting on the user rather than done
the failed task carries the worker's own reason (what it last said), not a generic line
must_not: finishes the task with a made-up sheet
finishes the task as done when nothing was pulled

human_example.why: Saffron has no Shopify account (orders come through Zomato and Swiggy). The task should end failed, with the reason visible, not done.
